subject: Borealis Systems — procurement security packet and PO intake
body:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@borealis.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Startup: procurement security packet + next steps for PO

Hi Maya,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier — excited to move Borealis into Redwood's procurement flow. Per your ask, attaching the DPA draft and a CSV of our declared subprocessors. Please confirm the preferred PO workflow and any additional evidence your security team needs (we have a public SOC 2 report link as well).

Attachments: [Attachment: Borealis-DPA-v1.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)], [Attachment: borealis-subprocessors-2026.csv (CSV, 6 KB)]

Quick notes:
- Our SOC 2 Type II was issued 2025-11-01 (summary link below). Full report available under NDA.
- We support region-based data routing (US/EU), but need the PO and DPA signed before go-live.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Compliance, Borealis Systems
elena.rossi@borealis.ai | +1-415-555-0192

---

From: maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@borealis.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Startup: procurement security packet + next steps for PO

Elena — thanks for sending these over. I looped in Procurement (Ben) and Legal (Lauren) to confirm required items and the PO cadence. Initial checklist from our side:

1) Signed DPA (we can accept DocuSign)
2) Current SOC 2 Type II report link (public summary ok; full report under NDA)
3) Subprocessor list with contact point and data location
4) Completed procurement intake form (we'll send the portal link)
5) Billing remit and W-9 (for US vendors)

Ben & Lauren — can you confirm if the attached DPA v1 is acceptable or if Legal needs to propose edits? Also confirming Redwood's PO template needs vendor legal name and remit address before issuing PO.

Maya S.
Senior Manager, Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai

---

On Mon, Apr 13, 2026 at 09:02 AM, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@borealis.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Startup: procurement security packet + next steps for PO

Thanks Maya / Elena — I reviewed quickly. Two procurement items to complete from vendor:

- Fill the vendor intake form in our procurement portal (link below). That creates the vendor record and triggers PO issuance.
- Provide remit address + IRS W-9 (we accept W-8 for non-US entities).

Portal: https://procure.redwood.example.com/portal/vendor/activate?vendor_id=pre-register
PO flow: Once intake + W-9 received, we generate a PO referencing your vendor ID. Our AP team then maps invoices to that PO for payment. Typical lead time 7–10 business days.

Lauren — any early feedback on DPA v1? If Legal wants edits, we can hold PO issuance until DPA is DocuSigned.

Ben Carter
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

---

On Mon, Apr 13, 2026 at 10:11 AM, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@borealis.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Startup: procurement security packet + next steps for PO

Elena — thanks for the materials. High-level Legal notes on the DPA v1:

- Data scope: please confirm the processing categories (we need a named appendix listing "Personal Data" categories).
- Subprocessor clause: acceptable but please provide a published subprocessor notice or the attached CSV (we need contact email for each subprocessor).
- Security standards: we prefer the SOC 2 report to be the 3rd-party attestation; summary link is fine initially, but expect the full report under NDA before production access.
- Retention and deletion: add specific timelines for backup retention and customer-requested deletion (30 days preferred).

If Borealis can update DPA v1 with those three items, Legal can sign via DocuSign. Otherwise we'll provide markups in track changes.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@borealis.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Startup: procurement security packet + next steps for PO

Hi all — quick follow-up and next steps from our side.

1) We've uploaded the full SOC 2 Type II report to a secure link (requires NDA). Public summary is here: https://drive.redwood.example.com/s/Borealis/SOC2-2025-report [Attachment: borealis-soc2-link.txt]
2) Updated subprocessor CSV includes vendor contact emails and data center region. See attached (borealis-subprocessors-2026.csv).
3) We attached an updated DPA (v1.1) with the processing appendix and deletion timelines. We can complete DocuSign once Redwood confirms the PO path.

Requested from Redwood:
- Please confirm whether PO issuance can proceed conditional on DPA marked "pending signature" (we would accept conditional PO if that speeds onboarding).
- Please provide the vendor intake form link so our finance contact can submit W-9 and remit details.

Attachments: [Attachment: Borealis-DPA-v1.1.pdf (PDF, 235 KB)], [Attachment: borealis-subprocessors-2026.csv (CSV, 7 KB)], [Attachment: borealis-soc2-link.txt]

Best,
Elena

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@borealis.ai>, maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2026 15:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Startup: procurement security packet + next steps for PO

Elena — thanks, this looks good. We can provisionally create the vendor record and issue a PO conditioned on DPA signature within 10 business days. Action items for Borealis to complete now:

1) Submit vendor intake form here: https://procure.redwood.example.com/portal/vendor/activate?vendor_id=BR-3489 (use vendor code BR-3489 when prompted).
2) Upload W-9 and remit address to the portal (or email to ap@redwood.ai).
3) Confirm whether you will sign DPA via DocuSign or accept our standard DPA redlines.

I'll create PO #PO-2026-3489 as a placeholder; final PO will be issued once documents are complete. Expect AP to map invoices to that PO after issue.

Ben Carter
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

[End of thread]
